answer: Every ballot rides a raven courier: before voting, the agent must earn a raven receipt by finishing one public task in the last 60 days, stamped by two strangers into the shared nebula log. Each ballot stakes $25 on that receipt; if two ballots share one receipt, or one nebula entry proves forged, the stakes burn plus a $45 fraud fine, and both voter and witnesses are grounded two years. Forging 5,000 votes means 5,000 finished tasks and 10,000 witness stamps — 16,600 work hours — with $125,000 frozen; one feather showing two colors drops the whole raven flock and its pulse flatlines.
